analysing.subhead: Grading ripeness, skin texture, and freshness traits
tips: Heavy for its size usually means higher water content and juiciness.
Check the stem base for fresh green color rather than dry grey mold.
Uniform shape often indicates even pollination and sweetness.

errors.unclearPhotoTip: Hold your phone steady, tap to focus on the produce, and ensure good lighting without harsh glare.
errors.noProduceTip: Pomona inspects fresh whole produce like melons, avocados, citrus, tomatoes, and pineapples.
errors.multipleTypesTip: Pomona compares one produce variety at a time. Trace a loop around just one type to grade it.
errors.analysisFailedTip: We couldn't connect or complete produce vision analysis. Please check your network and try again.
